systems.name: 5.1 Unlockable Characters & Skins
systems.notes: Start with one contestant; unlock others by completing challenges. Each character has unique starting weapon and passive ability.
tasks: Design 4 new player character sprites and stats
Challenge system: 'beat wave 25 with only melee', etc.
Skin variations unlockable via score milestones

systems.name: 5.2 Persistent Upgrades & Stat Tracking
systems.notes: Earn credits per run to spend on permanent upgrades (start with more HP, better weapon, free trinket). Use Star Leaderboard for global high scores.
tasks: Meta-currency earning based on run performance
Personal stats page (kills, deaths, favorite weapon)

systems.name: 5.3 Daily / Weekly Challenges
systems.notes: Daily seed run with fixed modifiers; global leaderboard for that seed. Encourages replayability.
